title: selliguea griffithiana
intro: Selliguea griffithiana, commonly known as Griffith's fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea griffithiana include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and act as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
